description: the default thread count is one
the sync is off by default and on with --no-sync
the packed text is not compared with its reference
LRS_RANK is not compared
the exit code needs only one of the RssAnon cap and a clean run
the text file holds the dense codes instead of the letters
the statistics file is written after the sync phase instead of before it
PH1 is given the bucket capacity of PH3
PH4 is given the chunk slots of PH1 as its chunk
the thread count is ignored by PH3
the thread count is ignored by PH4
the scratch directory is not deleted after a successful run
a failing run leaves its scratch directory
the rank file is not deleted after PH3
the tracker is not told that the rank file is gone
the suffix array file has n entries instead of n + 1
PH5 is not attached to the hook of PH4
the hook consumer is not called for the last chunk
off by one at the chunk boundary handed to PH5: every chunk loses its last value
the scratch tracker is not reset at the start of a run
the symbol counts are not computed
a block that is not a multiple of 8 is accepted
the second pass does not compare its counts with the first
the last partial byte of a block is truncated
the packed file has no padding
a failing run leaves its scratch directory (replacement of P13, which did not compile: the analyzer rejects a catch that only rethrows)
the tracker is told that 0 bytes of scratch are gone (replacement of P15, which did not compile: unused local)
the symbol counts are not computed (replacement of R01, which did not compile: empty block)
a block that is not a multiple of 8 is accepted (replacement of R05, which did not compile: redundant boolean)
the references are truncated instead of rounded
R of PH4 is rounded down
the reference K of PH3 is 2^20
an explicit R of PH4 is ignored
unscaled runs use the scale rule with a factor of one on ScaleN 0 (division by zero)
